ambient_events: A hound is done, and gets up, and the next one comes and sits without being called.
Twelve heads turn at the same moment toward the gate, and then turn back.
A collar is taken off its peg, checked, oiled, and hung back up.
Something enormous puts its chin on the bench and is elbowed off, gently.
description:
The shed at the end of the run: collars on pegs, a bench of ointments and clippers, a bin of feed with a scoop.

A man works down the line cleaning ears with a rag. The hounds are the size of ponies, some with the wrong number of eyes, one with a bone plate across its skull. Every one sits for him.

Sixteen pegs hold collars with no dogs, each labelled with a name.
name: The Houndyard
